sceneMotion.implementation: Native SVG transforms preserve the official prefab positions, anchors, scales and draw order: 3 pine trees, 1 round tree, flowering shrub, grass, flower, 3 clouds and mountain. CSS angular travel follows the 10/20/40/80-second periods and starting phases; sub-frame wrap transitions and wind deformation are approximated. Cart deformation follows the official 49/60-second keyframes.
